|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/dresseliancommando.html</ref>

Operatives in your outhouse? Outer Rim Scouts in your Swamp? Abyssins in your attic? Then these are your troops. Add a destiny to power against any non-unique alien, are immune &lt; 4, and stops opponent from drawing more than one destiny. Now thats some beatdown AND beatdown resistance! Whats more two Dresselains = a battle destiny draw! And remmeber their leader, [[Orrimaarko]] - together, they can inflict hurt on Imperials and aliens!

Combo: = power of 5+6+6 and if you set up two 6's (one added to power, one battle destiny) your total power is 29!
